result.title: Physics-Aware Deepfake Detection via Distance-Speech Consistency
result.summary: Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向动态说话视频提出物理感知的换脸检测器：利用真实录音中语音能量随说话者与摄像机距离可预测变化这一声学约束，把视频距离估计与语音的距离相关声学度量结合判别真假，并显示其与唇同步检测器互补。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用跨模态物理一致性作为判别证据」的思路，可能为 LVR 中核查视觉证据是否真正参与推理（而非旁路）提供审计式线索，可供人工核查；但该工作属判别式检测，不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，联系较远。
